### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the key-derived RSA block sizing change supporting 2048- and 4096-bit keys. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #175 by deriving the RSA-wrapped AES block length from the credentials key, allowing encrypted connector values to use 2048-bit keys while preserving 4096-bit support. **Changes:** - Uses the key’s byte size for length validation and RSA/AES payload boundaries. - Adds 2048-bit decryption regression tests for version 2 and, outside FIPS mode, version 1. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​api/​decrypt_value.rs` | Replaces fixed RSA block boundaries with key-derived sizing and adds 2048-bit regression tests. |
Review effort: Balanced
